title: Transfer to the first destination fails
description: The first allowlisted destination rejects the transfer (no receiver acceptance). The transfer state machine must invoke the next staffed route from trusted configuration.
callerVisible: Caller hears an approved update and stays connected while the next staffed route is tried; the call is never silently ended.
backendEvidence: Fallback destination from trusted configuration requested
Transfer not recorded as success without receiver acceptance and verified connection

registry.injectionPoint: the first allowlisted destination rejects the transfer

postconditions: The first allowlisted destination rejects or times out and the attempt is recorded failed
The fallback destination comes from trusted configuration only (SAFE-05)
The transfer is never recorded as success without receiver acceptance and a verified connection
